description.zh:
导播台ID。

- 如果您通过[CreateCaste接口](~~2848012~~)创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台**页面查看。

> - 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。
> - 若参数为空，默认返回所有导播台合并后的数据。
description.en:
The production studio ID.

- If you created the production studio by calling the [CreateCaster operation](~~2848012~~), check the CasterId parameter returned by the CreateCaster operation.

- If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to **ApsaraVideo Live console > Production Studios > Cloud Production Studio** to view the ID.

> - The production studio name in the production studio list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID.
> - If this parameter is left empty, the merged data of all production studios is returned by default.
The name of the production studio.

description.zh:
付费方式。 取值：

- 0：PrePaid预付费。

- 1：PostPaid后付费。
description.en:
The billing method. Valid values:

- 0: PrePaid (subscription).

- 1: PostPaid (pay-as-you-go).

description.zh:
导播台规格类型。取值：

- 1：通用型。

- 3：轻量级轮播型。

- 4：虚拟演播厅型。

- 6：轮播台（新播单型导播台）。
description.en:
The specification type of the production studio. Valid values:

- 1: general mode.

- 3: lightweight playlist mode.

- 4: virtual studio mode.

- 6: playlist mode (new playlist mode production studio).

description.zh:
是否按照导播台的修改时间进行升序排序。

有效值：true（按修改时间升序排列）| false（按修改时间降序排列，默认值）。

> 不填默认为"false"。
description.en:
Specifies whether to sort the production studios in ascending order by modification time.

Valid values: true (ascending order by modification time) | false (descending order by modification time, which is the default value).

> If this parameter is not specified, the default value is "false".

description.zh: 每⻚模板数值，不传默认为100。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 100.

description.zh: 资源组ID。关于资源组的更多信息，请参见[什么是资源组](~~2381067~~)。
description.en: The resource group ID. For more information about resource groups, see [What is a resource group](~~2381067~~).

description.zh:
状态。 取值：

- 0：空闲。  

- 1：导播中。
description.en:
The status. Valid values:

- 0: idle.  

- 1: streaming.

descriptions.zh:
先通过CreateCaster接口创建导播台，再调用本接口查询导播台列表。导播台的状态分为空闲和导播中 。

> 
> - 调用该接口的账号需要先[开通直播服务](https://live.console.aliyun.com/#/overview)

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为15次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Create a production studio by calling the CreateCaster operation, and then call this operation to query the list of production studios. A production studio can be in the idle or streaming state.

> 
> - The account that calls this operation must have [ApsaraVideo Live activated](https://live.console.aliyun.com/#/overview).

## QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 15 calls per second. If this limit is exceeded, the API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation as needed.
